requestDossierContact.description: Finds the live cult-dossier surveillance element on the page and calls its public requestContact() API, which logs a CONTACT entry and raises file integrity.

burnDossier.name: burnDossier
burnDossier.description: Finds the live cult-dossier surveillance element on the page and calls its public burn() API, which redacts every logged entry.

refreshCultStats.name: refreshCultStats
refreshCultStats.description: Re-scans the DOM for cult-stats.js data-stats-* hooks by calling window.CultStats.refresh(). Used on component mount so the head script picks up natively rendered nodes that mounted after its initial scan.

ditherMotifs.name: ditherMotifs
ditherMotifs.description: Self-contained animated dither motifs. Scans the document for canvas elements with a data-dither-motif attribute (rings | mark | waveform | moire | gauge) and drives a single requestAnimationFrame loop that renders each as a live black dot-grid on a transparent background. Cells are square; grid resolution derives from the canvas pixel size and an optional data-dither-cell (px) attribute. Re-scans on mount; cancels prior loops to avoid duplicates on SPA navigation.

spiralAscii.name: spiralAscii
spiralAscii.description: Self-contained animated ASCII log-spiral. Scans the document for <pre data-spiral> elements and drives a single requestAnimationFrame loop that fills each with its word's characters arranged on a rotating logarithmic spiral. Config via data attributes: data-spiral (the word), data-spiral-cols, data-spiral-rows, data-spiral-speed. Pauses offscreen elements, respects prefers-reduced-motion, re-scans on mount, and cancels prior loops to avoid stacking on SPA navigation.

spiralVortex.name: spiralVortex
spiralVortex.description: Self-contained animated ASCII log-spiral 'vortex' variant. Scans the document for <pre data-vortex> elements and drives a single requestAnimationFrame loop that fills each with a halftone character ramp arranged on an aggressive, fast-rotating multi-arm logarithmic spiral. Lower density cutoff, ramp-based edge falloff and per-cell grain give a premium gradient look rather than a wireframe. Config via data attributes: data-vortex (the word), data-vortex-speed. Pauses offscreen elements, respects prefers-reduced-motion, re-scans on mount, and cancels prior loops to avoid stacking on SPA navigation.

autoScrollLoop.name: autoScrollLoop
autoScrollLoop.description: Drives a seamless infinite auto-scroll on a horizontal carousel track while keeping it natively scrollable. The track must contain its cards duplicated once (first half identical to second half). Pass the track element's id and pixels-per-second speed. Auto-scroll pauses on hover, focus, and while the user drags/scrolls, then resumes.
